messages:
claire: heads-up: Vicario week0 private/VPC onboarding hit blocker. model pods failing to read secrets; KMS DENY in audit. need quick sync.
alyssa: noting renewal risk if unresolved >48h; PO review next Tue.
mohit: saw KMS DENY at 2026-03-10T14:02Z in our logs. likely missing IAM binding on node pool SA.
ryan: network: their egress SG only permits 443 to build-anchors. they must open outbound to kms.redwood-internal.example:443 and tcp/6514 to our audit collector. asked infra to update.
jaya: runbook requires `kms:Decrypt` for node SA and `kms:Encrypt` for cache SA. did they override node_service_account?
claire: they did via terraform override to tenant SA. alyssa, who made that change?
alyssa: Sonal (vicario infra lead) did. looping her in. @sonal please confirm SA email.
deploy-bot: deploy event: private-deploy/vicario/installer v1.2.3 applied 2026-03-10T13:50Z (ok).
mohit: mitigation: short-lived grant of `roles/redwood.kmsUser` scoped to node pool with 24h TTL. reduces downtime. any objections?
security-bot: alert: KMS key policy contains wildcard principal at 2026-03-09T22:14Z. replace with service-account-specific binding.
claire: prefer Mohit's wrapper key idea to limit blast radius. moh it, please draft.
mohit: will prototype a scoped wrapper + one-time signed token flow; ETA 3h.
ryan: firewall TF snippet to push in PR (ETA 2h). include ports 6514 and 443 and destination ranges for audit collector.
jaya: updating runbook: explicit SA mapping, audit sink checklist (`logSink.vpcFlow`), troubleshooting commands: `kubectl describe pod`, `kubectl get secret`, `gcloud kms keys list`, `curl` to collector.
alyssa: Sonal DMed SA: `vicario-central-sa@vicario-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`.
security-bot: policy-scan queued for that SA and the customer KMS key. results in ~15m.
claire: action items: Alyssa confirm SA owner and follow infra PR; Mohit prototype wrapper & TTL plan; Ryan push firewall PR; Jaya update runbook; Security validate KMS policy and propose least-priv binding; Claire draft renewal escalation note if not cleared in 48h.
claire: customer feedback: Sonal said onboarding felt slower than expected; add preflight clarity to post-onboard survey.
ryan: will include audit collector destination and sample TF in PR.
mohit: posting commands and expiry flow when ready.
claire: thanks all — update thread as you make progress. :white_check_mark:
